claims.claim: The summons-content requirement applies unless another statute requires otherwise.
claims.quote: Except as otherwise required by statute, a summons shall be directed to the defendant, signed by the clerk and issued under the seal of the court in which the action is pending, and it shall contain:

claims.claim: The summons must direct the defendant to file a written response with the court.
claims.quote: (3) A direction that the defendant file with the court a written pleading in response to the complaint within 30 days after summons is served on the defendant.

claims.claim: The stated deadline is within 30 days after the summons is served on the defendant.
claims.quote: within 30 days after summons is served on the defendant.
computed by excluding the first day

claims.claim: Include the last day unless it is a holiday.
claims.quote: and including the last, unless the last day is a holiday

claims.claim: If the last day is a holiday, exclude it.
claims.quote: unless the last day is a holiday, and then it is also excluded.

claims.claim: When the last day is a holiday, the deadline moves to the next nonholiday.
claims.quote: If the last day for the performance of any act provided or required by law to be performed within a specified period of time is a holiday, then that period is hereby extended to and including the next day that is not a holiday.

claims.claim: All day on Saturdays counts as a holiday for this deadline-extension rule.
claims.quote: For purposes of this section, “holiday” means all day on Saturdays

claims.claim: The cited form is Judicial Council summons form SUM-100, revised July 1, 2009.
claims.quote: Judicial Council form SUM-100 (Summons), Rev. July 1, 2009

claims.claim: SUM-100 specifies 30 calendar days after service of the summons and legal papers.
claims.quote: You have 30 CALENDAR DAYS after this summons and legal papers are served on you

claims.claim: SUM-100 directs the defendant to file a written response at the court.
claims.quote: to file a written response at this court

claims.claim: SUM-100 also directs the defendant to have a copy served on the plaintiff within that period.
claims.quote:
You have 30 CALENDAR DAYS after this summons and legal papers are served on you to file a written response at this court and have a copy
served on the plaintiff.

result.summary: The provided sources support the deadline, counting rules, and quoted form instructions within the stated scope.
